title: Gomen
description: Collard greens braised soft with red onion, garlic, ginger, and green chilli in spiced Ethiopian butter. A fixture of any shared injera platter.
notes: Olive oil in place of the niter kibbeh makes it vegan and fit for fasting days.

ingredients.name: niter kibbeh
ingredients.note: Ethiopian spiced butter; or butter with a pinch of cardamom

steps.text: Strip the collard greens from their stems and chop the leaves into small pieces.
Cook the red onion in the niter kibbeh until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and green chillies and stir for a minute.
Add the collards and water, cover, and cook until completely tender.
steps.tip: Ethiopian gomen is cooked soft, not bright and crunchy.

steps.text: Uncover, season with salt, and cook off any remaining liquid.
